name: woopiai-hub
description: WoopiAI Hub - Root package for formatting and linting

scripts.format:changed: npm run format && npm run format:frontend && npm run format:backend
scripts.setup:hooks: node -e "const {execSync} = require('child_process'); const os = require('os'); const isWindows = os.platform() === 'win32'; execSync(isWindows ? 'powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/setup-git-hooks.ps1' : 'bash scripts/setup-git-hooks.sh', {stdio: 'inherit'})"
